jou.text: Zosimos, walking by the woods, was overtaken by worry that he would die without ever gaining the favor of the gods, as other heroes had.

A satyr sprang onto the path and told him his mind's garden was full of weeds, saying that worry was Phenax's creation, and taught him that a true hero is concerned with the flowering of goodness rather than titles or a death mask.
The satyr gave him a taste of nectarvine sap, told him the world is good, and handed him a dull, rusty knife, warning that darkness would try to snuff out an awakened hero's light.
Transformed, Zosimos left the path to Meletis and followed a pull toward the eastern mountains, and the satyr's dagger burst into heat and light, becoming a shining sword forged by the gods.
